headline: Sensex stuck in range while Nifty holds near 23,000 as India VIX drops over 7%

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex remained range-bound with Nifty near 23,000, while India VIX slumped over 7%.
Elevated crude oil prices and higher yields weighed on market sentiment, keeping broader gains muted.
Sectoral divergence continued as auto and realty stocks posted gains while IT shares faced selling pressure.
The market reflects ongoing consolidation after Sensex dropped nearly 3,300 points and Nifty dipped 1,000 points in recent weeks.
whatHappening: The government is currently evaluating financial bids for the strategic stake sale in IDBI Bank.
Motilal Oswal group received a custodian licence from SEBI to begin operations in Q4.
Suzuki announced plans to halve vehicle development time by 2030 and boost its manufacturing capacity in India.
Waaree Clean Energy CEO Anuj Sharma stated that demand for specialty gases is expected to grow multifold.
summary: Indian benchmark indices traded in a narrow range on Friday, with Nifty holding close to 23,000 as market volatility fell sharply. High crude oil prices and global yield pressures kept market momentum restrained despite buying in auto and realty shares. Corporate developments in IDBI Bank, Motilal Oswal, and Suzuki provided stock-specific triggers.
